canonical_title: Google assembles roughly $200B TPU and data-center financing machine for Anthropic
treatment: Treat as an AI infrastructure financing and TPU supply-chain topic. Reinclude only for material changes to committed TPU capacity, financing structure, Google/Broadcom guarantees, Anthropic lease obligations, data-center capacity, defaults, or independently confirmed revisions to the reported contract totals.
known_facts: Financial Times reported on 2026-08-04 that contracts underpinning Google's TPU and data-center supply operation for Anthropic total roughly $200B.

FT reported that about four-fifths of the total is tied to AI chips, with Broadcom disclosing $128B of purchase commitments associated almost entirely with 3.5GW of TPU hardware for Anthropic through fiscal 2028.

A June financing tranche used a special-purpose vehicle called Compute SPV to buy roughly $35B of TPU hardware representing about 1GW, with debt anchored by Apollo and Blackstone and residual-value support from Broadcom.
FT identified Google-backed data-center financing across multiple former crypto-mining operators and reported Google has backstopped 10 developments totaling about 2.4GW of power for TPUs.
FT reported Google's maximum exposure to those lease guarantees could reach about $44B, while the company marks a much smaller liability on its balance sheet.

The structure lowers financing costs for Google-backed TPU projects and shifts part of the capital burden to private-credit vehicles, Broadcom, and data-center developers rather than keeping all hardware and project debt directly on Google's balance sheet.
reinclude_only_if: Google, Anthropic, Broadcom, or financing partners officially confirm or materially revise the reported $200B contract structure.
Broadcom materially changes the $128B TPU purchase commitments or 3.5GW delivery schedule.
Anthropic, Google, or an SPV encounters a material payment, refinancing, lease, capacity, or default event.
Additional financing tranches materially change the reported 4.5GW TPU deployment plan or Google's guarantee exposure.
Credible reporting establishes a major cost, performance, or market-share effect versus Nvidia-centered infrastructure financing.
notes: NEW because the detailed financing architecture, SPV structure, Broadcom residual-value support, purchase commitments, and aggregate contract scale had not previously been recorded in the canonical ledger. Distinct from earlier Google-Anthropic investment or compute-capacity announcements.
